notes: LiveMaker: game.dat carries the 'vff' archive magic at offset 0 (https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html), and .lsb are the engine's script binaries (https://github.com/pmrowla/pylivemaker). The head-regex is paired with the file-name condition so a differently-cased game.dat simply fails the rule instead of matching on the name alone.
